10 استكفأه إِبِلَهُ He asked him for a year's produce of his camels; i.e., their young ones in the womb in one year; (S, TA;) or their hair and wool, milk, and young ones, of one year. (TA.) ―
-b2- استكفأه نَخْلَةً He asked him for a year's produce of a palm-tree. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
